name: encoding-reflection-field-walk
description: A reflective walk over a type's fields reads every field of that type, exported or not, written or not, because what it checks or prints is the set of fields itself: a reflect call whose result may reach NumField, Field or FieldByIndex of a reflect.Type or a reflect.Value, or reflect.VisibleFields, reflect.TypeFor's type argument included. A reflect call whose result reaches none of them reads the fields the program writes, so a field nothing writes is still reported.
